response.sql: WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.healtheval AS status, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM site_ratio) SELECT g.site_code, g.status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - o.mean_ratio AS beat_by FROM site_ratio g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY beat_by DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: chronotag is compared as text with inclusive BETWEEN bounds, as the request specifies; the schema declares it text(6) while the documentation says TIMESTAMP, but the request settles the comparison as text.
Scans are linked to sites by scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry using an inner join, so scans without a matching site are dropped.
Scans with NULL gbsize or NULL spanmin, and scans with spanmin = 0 (to avoid division by zero), are excluded before aggregation, so scan_count counts only the scans that contribute to the average.

Groups are formed by site code and healtheval; a NULL healtheval forms its own group. The mean is the unweighted AVG of the group averages. If no group has a computable average, the mean is NULL and no rows are returned.
beat_by is the group average minus the mean of group averages, unrounded, and the sort puts NULLs last.

alternatives.interpretation: scan_count counts every scan in the group, including scans with missing gbsize or spanmin. Missing values are skipped only in the average, so groups whose scans all lack a ratio still exist but are excluded from the mean and the result.
alternatives.sql: WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.healtheval AS status, AVG(CASE WHEN sc.spanmin <> 0 THEN sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin END) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM site_ratio) SELECT g.site_code, g.status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - o.mean_ratio AS beat_by FROM site_ratio g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY beat_by DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
